What we clean

A service for every space you need to care for

Whether it's your home, your office, or your business, we adapt the crew, the products, and the time to what your space actually needs.

Residential cleaning

Kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and common areas, leaving your home ready to live in without thinking about dust.

Commercial cleaning

Offices, storefronts, and clinics, ready before your team or your customers walk in.

Deep cleaning

For the spots that build up over time: appliances, windows, and hard-to-reach areas.

Move-in / move-out & post-construction

Hand over or move into a spotless space, free of paint residue, construction dust, or leftover boxes.

Plans by frequency

Choose the rhythm that fits your space

No forced contracts. Adjust or change your frequency whenever you need to.

Monthly

Monthly upkeep

A complete cleaning once a month for spaces that stay tidy between visits.

Best for: low-traffic homes or small offices that already have their own tidying routine.
  • General cleaning of all areas
  • Deep clean of bathrooms and kitchen
  • Dusting of all surfaces
  • Easy rescheduling if plans change
Request a quote
Most popular Weekly

Weekly care

Our clients' favorite: your space always ready, so clutter never has a chance to build up.

Best for: busy families, homes with pets, offices with heavy foot traffic.
  • Everything in the monthly plan
  • Priority scheduling and set days
  • Extra attention to kitchen and bathrooms every visit
Request a quote
Biweekly

Biweekly balance

The middle ground: consistent freshness without needing a visit every single week.

Best for: couples, roommates, or businesses with moderate foot traffic.
  • Everything in the monthly plan
  • Rotating deep-clean tasks each visit
  • Flexibility to shift your date
  • A great starting point

How it works

From quote to a spotless space in 3 steps

01

03

Enjoy the result
